verdict.rationale: Intuit documents a QuickBooks Online V3 REST API with official SDKs, and its official MCP server exposes 11 financial reports covering Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow "and more". So a documented programmatic route to financial reports exists, but the general ledger and trial balance are never named. missing for 10: explicit evidence that General Ledger and Trial Balance reports are available via the API, documentation of open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV), evidence of full-ledger completeness or pagination, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats

citations.quote: PHP client for connecting to the QuickBooks Online V3 REST API.
11 Financial Reports - Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, and more
It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
